notes: Generated routing and basic-output starter. Curate realistic prompts and example-backed task scenarios before treating it as behavior evidence.

should_trigger.prompt: Please define sales stages, exit criteria, and required proof that managers can inspect and RevOps can enforce.
Please tighten stage hygiene, standardize progression rules, or connect qualification evidence to forecasting.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable pipeline stage definition and exit criteria and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please inspect one live opportunity and produce an evidence-backed manager view of stage validity, deal risk, missing proof, and next actions.
Please build a concise forecast risk brief that highlights commit risk, slippage, and intervention priorities for sales leadership.
Please analyze a defined set of sales calls or notes and produce an evidence-backed objection brief by segment, persona, or stage.

output_structure_checks.name: pipeline-stage-definition-and-exit-criteria-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Produces Stage card table: stage name, purpose, entry criteria, exit criteria, required proof; Recommended proof and exception owner by stage.

output_structure_checks.name: pipeline-stage-definition-and-exit-criteria-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.
